{{Quote|Those who don't live here wish they did.|Saying among Core Worlders|<ref name="TEA" />}}
The '''Core Worlds''' (also known as the '''Galactic Core''' and, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the '''Imperial Core''') were some of the most prestigious, well-developed, well-known, least politically restrictive and heavily populated planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref><ref name="TEA" /> In astrophysical terms, the Core denoted the central area of the galaxy, and in broad terms this was true enough, but the precise usage of the term was often more complex.

The major [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] hyperlanes radiated outwards around little more than half the galactic disk, and the Core Worlds occupied a C-shaped region of space around the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the heart of the astrophysical core (generally considered to be a separate outlier area), extending outwards towards the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

The Core was the hub of galactic culture, finance, technology, education, and fine arts. Noble houses held a great deal of influence in this region and almost every interstellar company had offices or were headquartered in the Core Worlds. The astrographic home of the elite, the proudest governments, the wealthiest corporations and [[Factory world/Legends|factory planets]], the Core Worlds were shielded from economic hazards and hardships; even though life was expensive and every world had its own poorest slums, and there was a constant migration wave towards it.<ref name="TEA" /> 

==History==
{{Quote|Who controls Coruscant controls the Core, and without the Core, the Alliance is nothing.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]]|<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
===[[Pre-Republic era]]===
For much of galactic history, little was known about the history and cultures of the Core Worlds prior to the formation of the Galactic Republic in [[25,053 BBY]]. Among many prominent galactic circles, it was believed that [[Human/Legends|Humans]] originated in one of the Core Worlds. It was widely speculated that [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the birthplace of humanity though there was little to no [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] evidence to support that theory.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Around [[1,000,000 BBY]], the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] created the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] by using the massive [[Centerpoint Station]] to tractor the five planets [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] around the star [[Corell/Legends|Corell]]. The planets were then settled with [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]], [[Drall/Legends|Dralls]] and humans from Coruscant; resulting in the system's multi-species population. The Celestials also used similar technology to construct the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]].<ref name="TNEC" />

[[File:Centerpoint_Station.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Centerpoint Station]].]]
Millennia ago, war broke out on Coruscant between the [[near-Human]] [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] and the 13 baseline Human nations of the [[Zhell/Legends|Battalions of Zhell]]. A volcano decimated the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], the ash filling the skies for two years, so the Taungs adopted the name ''Dha Werda Verda'' (Warriors of Shadow) for themselves. The Human Zhell eventually recovered and drove the Taungs offworld.<ref name="TEC" /><ref name="TNEC" /> Around [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], Coruscant and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] homeworld of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] were surveyed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]], who dismissed the native civilizations on these worlds as primitive disappointments.<ref name="TNEC" /> During this period, Coruscant's surface was gradually covered by the planet-spanning [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. New buildings were built on the old. As a result, there was virtually no exposed land. In the forgotten [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]] of the city, there was darkness, pollution and crime. Higher up, there were government offices and penthouses owned by the elite.

In [[35,000 BBY]], the insectoid [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] built the [[Castle Lands]] of Oroboro. At some point, the Killiks colonized nearby [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. They were taken away from Alderaan [[30,000 BBY]] by the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] after consuming all of Alderaan's natural resources, and long believed extinct by the galaxy until re-encountered in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].<ref name="DN1:TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

[[File:Skako.jpg|thumb|210px|[[Skako/Legends|Skako]] in the Core Worlds]]Between 35,000 BBY to [[25,200 BBY]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] conquered and enslaved the inhabitants of several worlds within the Core region including, Duro and the Corellian systems. Slaves from these worlds were used to build the [[Star Forge]] in [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Under Rakatan domination, the Humans of Coruscant's colonization attempts were limited to sleeper ships, which ended up on Alderaan, in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], [[Seoul 5]], [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Axum]], [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]], [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] and many other worlds.<ref name="TNEC" /> The Rakata were eventually decimated by a massive plague, leading to slave revolutions on their subject worlds in the Core.<ref name="TNEC" />

Over the next two centuries, Coruscant was linked to other Core Worlds including Corellia, Alderaan, New Plympto and Duro, by [[hyperspace cannon]]s, via the [[Herglic Trade Empire]].<ref name="TNEC" /> It was during this time that the Coruscant government peacefully absorbed the nearby [[Azure Imperium]]. During these pre-Republic years, the languages of Coruscant and its neighbors meshed to become [[Old Galactic Standard]].<ref name="CCW" /> Before the invention of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], galactic civilization was limited to the Core Worlds. Densely populated and heavily industrialized, the Core Worlds gradually developed into a socio-economic power house essential for galactic domination over the millennia.<ref name="CCW" />

===Rise of the Republic===
[[File:Uglykotoricon.svg|thumb|right|150px|The earliest known symbol of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], dominant government of this period.]]
In [[25,053 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was born with the signing of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] in the aftermath of the [[Unification Wars (Galactic Republic)|Unification Wars]]. Its founders were a number of key Core Worlds known collectively as the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] including Coruscant, Alderaan, Duro, Kuat and [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]].<ref name="TNEC" /> As an early founder of the Republic, Duro entered a golden age under the leadership of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]]. Later, the monarchy was abolished in favor of a collection of ruling corporations administrated by the [[Duros High House]] which was led by a [[Chief Representative Officer]]. During that period, Human and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] scientists reverse-engineered the [[Force-drive|Rakatan hyperdrive]]; inventing the modern [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. This led to vigorous colonization in a small patch of the Core known as the [[Tetrahedron]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Tetrahedron was based on the concepts of a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] hyperspatial physicist who theorized that Coruscant, Alderaan, Corellia and the [[Ginn Jump/Legends|Ginn Jump]] were the four corners of a specific region of space.<ref name="TEA" /> Due to its strategic location and heavy infrastructure, Coruscant was the capital of the Republic; thus bearing the coordinates 0-0-0 on [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] maps. The discovery of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] linked Coruscant to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], which became the domain of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] over the subsequent millennia and a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] blocking [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] expansion into the Core.<ref name="TNEC" /> Over the next millennia, the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] was mapped, linking Coruscant to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and beyond. The wedge defined by the two trade routes became known as "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]." The Core Worlds' portion of the Slice was known as the [[Arrowhead]], and soon the Republic expanded into the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Several Core Worlds like [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], [[Basilisk]] and [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]] prospered from this territorial boom.<ref name="TEA" />

The eastern portion of the Core was first colonized, and it formed a semicircle hugging the Deep Core; from Coruscant to the galactic north, and [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] to the south. The colonization to the western portion followed, but the worlds of "[[The Negs]]" never reached the same prestige.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[24,000 BBY]], war broke out between the Republic and the Union; spreading both sides of the Perlemian. The Republic won by turning the Hutts against the Tionese; ending the Union's existence as an independent state and paving the way for galactic domination by the Core-based Republic.<ref name="TNEC" /> By [[23,900 BBY]], the worlds of the former Honorable Union had all joined the Republic with the exception of [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] which remained proudly isolationist. At first, the government on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] wished for slow expansion, despite its promotion of hyperspace exploration. However, against the government's wishes, the membership of the Republic boomed for its first millennium of existence, mainly due to worlds wishing to join as protection against [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="GATOR">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

During the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] ([[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]]&ndash;[[17,000 BBY]]), the Republic expanded eastwards across the galaxy into the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Despite this, the Slice would remain the heart of navigable space.<ref name="TNEC" /> Eventually, the Republic expanded past the galactic-northern and -southern borders of the Slice, though most of the galaxy was still unknown, except for outposts such as [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] ([[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]]) and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] ([[8000 BBY]]).<ref name="TNEC" /> The space west of Coruscant still remained unexplored since analogues to the Perlemian Trade Route and the Corellian Run in that direction still had not been discovered. Worse, progress was limited to dangerous one- or two-light-year jumps into a stretch of [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|hyperspatial anomalies]]. Consequently, the Republic government expanded eastward, instead.<ref name="TNEC" />

During this period, several key Core Worlds including Coruscant and Alsakan established holdings in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. However, this region suffered greatly as a result of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] attempting to snatch control of the Republic from Coruscant.<ref name="HSATCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> This resulted in seventeen [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], spanning from 17,000 BBY to [[3017 BBY]]. However, most of the fighting took place between their holdings in the Expansion Region, rather than in the Core itself. Needless to say, Coruscant won every conflict it fought.<ref name="HSATCSS" /> In [[15,500 BBY]], after a disastrous first contact, Coruscant was assaulted by [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Star Dragons]] in the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]]. The conflict was peacefully resolved by Supreme Chancellor [[Fillorean]] and the Star Dragon philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]], who together founded the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]].<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], the Core Worlds came under the influence of the theocratic and [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] sect which posited one of their own [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] as the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic.<ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> Over the following centuries, his descendants sanctioned several [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] against some rival alien sects in the Outer Rim which fought back; leaving the galaxy in a never-ending state of alternating hot and cold wars.<ref name="TTSP" /> During this period, several military outposts known as [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]] were established to ostensibly protect [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers from hostile alien threats. This further deepened interspecies tensions with the anti-alien nature of the crusades forcing an exodus into [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and turning the [[The Slice/Legends|Rimward Slice]] into a militarized zone dominated by war profiteers.<ref name="TEA" /> Though Pius Dea rule came to an end in [[11,000 BBY]], the repercussions of these crusades would sour relations between the Core and the Outer Rim over the millennia.<ref name="TNEC" />

===The Sith Wars===
[[File:BattleOfCoruscant1-TSW2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Core planets like Coruscant were the sites of key battles during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].]]
During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Coruscant was invaded by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] which quickly overwhelmed the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. With the destruction of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] above [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], the Sith forces were driven back by reinforcements from Anaxes. Republic forces then invaded and devastated [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]], ending the Sith Empire.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[4250 BBY]], the [[Third Great Schism]] was fought on Coruscant with the surviving Dark Jedi fleeing to the [[Vultar system/Legends|Vultar system]]. The Dark Jedi discovered that the system had been artificially constructed by the Celestials and attempted to use the ancient machinery including the [[Cosmic Turbine]] but ended up destroying themselves and the system during the [[Vultar Cataclysm]].<ref name="TNEC" />

By [[4225 BBY]], Kaikielius had become impoverished and became a crime hub dominated by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. A joint [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force ousted the Hutts and other criminal elements, and the planet was rebuilt with Republic aid. In [[4015 BBY]], the [[Great Droid Revolution]] on Coruscant was defeated but sparked an increased [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid sentiment]] among the galactic populace. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and their [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] allies attacked several Core Worlds including [[Basilisk]], [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Following the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|devastation of Ossus]] in [[3996 BBY]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] took up residence in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant, to which many Jedi relics from Ossus were taken. The Temple was greatly expanded and rebuilt over the preceding millennia.<ref name="TEA" />

Much of the Core Worlds largely escaped the devastation of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Sith Civil War]] since most of the fighting occurred in the outer galaxy. In [[3962 BBY]], the Mandalorians devastated much of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Great Galactic War]], the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and their Mandalorian allies blockaded the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]; depriving the Core Worlds of vital supplies and raw goods from the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and Outer Rim. This sparked rioting on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and there was talk in the Senate of complete surrender to the Sith. However, the Republic's situation was alleviated by the intervention of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] smuggler [[Hylo Visz]] who succeeded in breaking the Mandalorian blockade.<ref name="Timeline2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> The Sith then offered to negotiate a peace with the Republic on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[3653 BBY]]. With the Republic and Jedi caught off guard, a Sith fleet invaded and [[Sacking of Coruscant|rampaged]] the galactic capital; inflicting much damage to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The Republic was forced to signed the uneven [[Treaty of Coruscant]] which ceded territories to the Sith. This set the stage for the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] which was marked by border skirmishes and proxy wars.<ref name="SWTORTOPA1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>

In [[3017 BBY]], Coruscant won the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]], ending a long line of conflicts with its rival Alsakan. This sealed Coruscant's dominance as the galaxy's political and economic center with a monopoly on sponsoring colonization and settlement of outlying systems.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[3000 BBY]], [[Corellia StarDrive]] was bought out by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] following the death of its design team.<ref name="TNEGTVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

By [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]], the Republic had entered a "[[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age]]" after centuries of protracted warfare with various Sith factions including the [[New Sith]] Empire. This period was marked by excessive corruption, corporate bankruptcy, rampant lawlessness and the exhaustion of mineral reserves. The Republic could no longer afford to maintain the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] beyond the Core Worlds, so communications between worlds outside the Core had to be maintained through couriers. Even worse, a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]] epidemic of [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]] killed off as much as two-thirds of the population of some worlds. The Jedi wielded greater influence in the Republic government and took control of the office of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Although the unity of the Sith seems to have been broken by infighting, the situation wore down the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and [[Republic Army|Army]], which likewise fell under increasing Jedi control. During the [[Light and Darkness War]] ([[1010 BBY]]&ndash;[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]), [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan's]] reorganized [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] struck deep into the Core and managed to capture [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] but failed to take the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

===Fall of the Republic===
[[File:Tarsus_Valorum-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Supreme Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum's]] [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] brought significant changes to relations between the Core and the "Outer Galaxy"]]
Following the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]&mdash;the first non-Jedi Supreme Chancellor in centuries&mdash;enacted the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] that reduced the power of the Chancellor, increased the Galactic Senate's power and abolished the Republic's military. The Ruusan Reformation also attempted to reduce corruption and decentralize power away from a few powerful Coreward sectors that dominate representation by reorganizing the then-existing millions of sectors into only 1,024 sectors. Each of the new sectors was granted its own Senator, although a few exemptions were made for politically powerful core worlds to retain their individual representation. Other slots, such as those for species types and cultural entities were also granted. By increasing the power of the Senate however, this increased gridlock and the loss of representation for many worlds and systems.<ref name="TEA" />

The subsequent era was marked by the lack of full-scale conflict in the region which largely recovered and prospered. However, small short-lived conflicts and threats still occurred.<ref name="TEA" /> Circa [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]], Corellia allied with [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] and [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] in a failed attempt to conquer the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]].<ref name="AAC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref> In [[470 BBY]], Corellia attempted to secede from the Republic; although progressing far enough to close its sector's borders and withdraw from the Senate using [[Contemplanys Hermi]], the plan ultimately failed and the system continued as a begrudging Republic member-state.<ref name="TNEC" /> In [[380 BBY/Legends|380 BBY]], the Corellian [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Keiran Halcyon]] defeated the [[Afarathu]] pirates, a sect of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] terrorists, whom were trying to kill all Humans on Corellia.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> The Afarathu were not gone forever, and would plague Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> In [[312 BBY]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Berethron e Solo]] established a parliamentary constitutional monarch, replacing his own [[Corellian empire|absolute monarchy]].<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> In [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]], the Royal [[Solo family/Legends|House of Solo]] was overthrown by Corellia's powerful conglomerates including [[Gowix Computers]], the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] and the Corellian Engineering Cooperation which then proceeded to install a pro-business government known as the [[Diktat]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Coreworlds.jpg|thumb|200px|Core Worlds map dating to nearly the end of the Republic.]]

At some point, a group of Human inhabitants from the Core Worlds decided that the urban sprawl of their region, the stress of urban society and the lack of peaceful coexistence with others was not for them. They decided to settle [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]], an unimportant world in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] near the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="g10">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the terrorist organization [[The Flail]], accusing the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of corruption, disrupted public services of Coruscant, including commerce, communications, traffic and weather, destroying property and lives while doing so. They were stopped by agents of Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], a distant descendant of Tarsus Valorum.<ref name="SOC">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref>

Following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the secret [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] became [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Coruscant was almost destroyed by [[Ashaar Khorda]] using the [[Infant of Shaa]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], and [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] saved Coruscant, although Poof [[Skirmish at Coruscant's power core|sacrificed]] himself to do so. News of this averted disaster was never widely divulged, however. By [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the stability of the Core Worlds was threatened by the successes of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Senate was divided between supporters and opponents of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. While most of the Core Worlds remained firmly loyal to the Republic, the Separatists found support in the various outlying worlds and sectors of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the Outer Rim. The secession of Republic worlds like [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] resulted in a mass exodus of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthians]] from Coruscant. In response to growing tensions, the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] under [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] declared neutrality and temporarily left the Republic, yet again invoking ''Contemplanys Hermi''.<ref name="TNEC" />

Throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Coruscant and other Core Worlds were subject to frequent Separatist terrorist acts, assassinations and military campaigns. During the [[Dark Reaper crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Separatist forces under [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] destroyed the planet [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin's]] geothermal generators, disrupting the region's power supply.<ref name="TNEC" /> Separatist uprisings on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] and [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] were quickly suppressed by Republic and Jedi forces.<ref name="TNEC" /> Coruscant itself was [[Coruscant/Legends|raided]]<ref name="Star Wars: The New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref> while several prominent Republic officials including former Chancellor Finis Valorum<ref name="Star Wars Republic 61: Dead Ends">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> and Senator [[Viento]] were assassinated by Separatist agents.<ref name="Star Wars Republic 63: Striking from the Shadows">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref> That year, the [[Statute 312b|Fourth Constitutional Amendment]] gave Republic worlds in the Core, Colonies, and Inner Rim more voting power than worlds in the Expansion Region and beyond.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Foerost campaign]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Separatist [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo's]] [[Bulwark Fleet]] smashed through the Republic [[Battle of Foerost (Clone Wars)|blockade]] at Foerost and devastated several key Republic outposts throughout the strategically-important [[Imperial Center Oversector|Sector Zero]]. In response, the Republic launched the [[Victory Fleet]]&mdash; led by Captains [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], and consisting of the newly developed [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]]. The two fleets clashed at [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Basilisk]] which culminated in the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|defeat]] of Ningo's forces at Anaxes. For his efforts, Screed was placed in charge of the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous's]] forces succeed in capturing the Core Worlds of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during [[Operation Durge's Lance]].<ref name="TTSP" /> Grievous' forces also [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|orbitally bombarded and depopulated]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] and unleashed the [[Brainrot Plague|Loedorvian Brain Plague]] that exterminated all humans in the [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Republic forces under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] recaptured the strategically important world of [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]] which allowed Coruscant to seize control of the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]]. This and another string of victories at Duro, [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] and [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] turned the tide of the war in the Republic's favor, forcing the Separatist fleet to retreat to the Mid and Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="TNEC" /> The Republic's capital became increasingly fortified and the [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|COMPOR]] succeeded in pressuring the Coruscant government into deporting all members of species whose homeworld had joined the Confederacy.

Despite the numerous precautions taken, the Confederacy succeeded in making a surprise [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|raid]] on Coruscant. Bypassing the heavily fortified Corellian sector by use of secret hyperspace routes through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] provided by Darth Sidious, a Separatist fleet under General Grievous attacked Coruscant. With the Republic and Jedi defenders preoccupied, Grievous and his elite [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] captured Palpatine. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] succeeded in rescuing the Supreme Chancellor from the infamous Separatist flagship [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. The battle eventually turned in the Republic's favor and the Separatist armada was forced into a full retreat.<ref name="TEA" />

===[[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]===
[[File:Anaxes.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces parade over the skies of Anaxes.]]
At the conclusion of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was reorganized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Due to its strategic location and economic power base, the Core became a key Imperial stronghold. Following [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order]], Coruscant was renamed the Imperial Center. Most key Human-dominated Core Worlds including Coruscant, Kuat and Anaxes that loyally supported the Republic's war effort during the Clone Wars transferred this support to the Empire. During the Imperial period, the Republic's unofficial policy of [[humanocentrism]] became law with the Empire's promotion of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]].<ref name="TEC" /> Non-human species on Coruscant were forced to live in segregated [[ethnic neighborhood]]s while various alien homeworlds in the Core including [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], [[Orooturoo]] and [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] were subject to Imperial atrocities.<ref name="TEA" /> Following a prolonged [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]] on pro-Separatist New Plympto led by the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Purge]] survivor [[Dass Jennir]], the Nosaurians were brutally subjugated and enslaved, being treated as little more than animals.<ref name="SWDT2">[[Dark Times 2|''Dark Times'' 2]]</ref> In retaliation to Caamasi opposition to Imperial policies, Palpatine ordered the [[Caamas Firestorm|bombardment]] of Caamas in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] agents sabotaged the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] while the Imperial fleet leveled the planet's surface; destroying much of the natural environment and forcing the species offworld.<ref name="TEC" /> However, while [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR’s]] promotion of human superiority was heavily embraced on human-dominated planets, these attitudes quickly diminished on non-human Core Worlds.<ref>[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook'']]</ref>

Several notable Imperial figures including [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] Director [[Ysanne Isard]], and [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]]<ref name="TTSP" /> came from various Core Worlds. However, the region was also home to several prominent opponents of the Galactic Empire. The founders of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] Senators [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] were from Chandrila and Alderaan respectively as was the former Corellian senator Garm Bel Iblis.<ref name="TEC" /> Other prominent Alliance figures from the Core Worlds included future [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]],and the former [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="TEC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], pro-Imperial factions began to infiltrate Ralltiir's financial system and steer its markets in favor of the Empire. This included erasing the fiscal records of alien investors. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Rebel sympathizers within the [[Ralltiiri High Council]] tried to stop this and restore balance to the markets. In response, an Imperial force under [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tion (Lord)/Legends|Tion]] [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|invaded]] the planet.<ref name="The Far Orbit Project">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> Imperial forces then disbanded the High Council, placed the planet under military occupation and interned its population in camps.<ref name="TEC" /> Tion also sealed off the entire [[Ralltiir system/Legends|Ralltiir system]] (not even permitting relief organizations to travel through his [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|blockade]]), severely damaging commerce along the Perlemian.<ref name="CCW" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Leia Organa went on a mercy mission to deliver medical supplies and equipment to the Raltiiri High Council. She was permitted to land by Tion himself. There, Leia rescued a wounded Rebel soldier, who later revealed the existence of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="SWE5:PW">[[Empire 5|''Empire'' 5]]</ref> Shortly later, the Death Star under the command of Darth Vader and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] destroyed the prominent Core world of Alderaan; killing billions and prompting many outraged sentients to support the Rebel Alliance. Shortly afterwards, the Death Star was destroyed at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the Corellian capital, was the site of a [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|heated skirmish]] between Imperial forces and elements of the Alliance including the elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] whom succeeded in rescuing the former [[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commando]] Madine from Imperial custody.<ref name="Rogue Squadron">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a Rebel team led by Leia infiltrated Coruscant in an attempt to solicit the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Black Sun leader Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] assistance in uncovering the assassins who were targeting Alliance leader [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. However, this proved to be a trap and Skywalker hatched a plot to rescue the Alliance delegates. In the ensuing skirmish, Xizor's palace was destroyed and the Prince himself met his demise at the hands of Vader whose flagship [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] obliterated Xizor's skyhook.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Taking advantage of the chaos, the traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] attempted a coup against the two Sith Lords but was eliminated by loyalist Imperial forces.<ref name="TEC" />

===[[New Republic era]]===
[[File:RebelVictoryAtCoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|New Republic forces capture Coruscant in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].]]
During the late stages of the Galactic Civil War, the Core Worlds switched hands several times between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the Empire. With the death of the Emperor and Darth Vader during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the region was carved up by various Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]. Coruscant was the site of a short-lived anti-Imperial [[Coruscant uprising|uprising]] which was suppressed by Imperial forces under the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] and Isard. While the former assumed control of the galactic capital, he was challenged by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] which was secretly manipulated by Isard. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Alliance's successor state the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] captured Ralltiir, [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], the latter an influential Core World near Chandrila. Isard manipulated Pestage into losing strategically-important Brentaal to the New Republic as a means of undermining the latter's position in power.<ref name="TEC" />

When Pestage's secret negotiations with the New Republic to cede Coruscant in exchange for an independent fiefdom in the Outer Rim became public, the Ruling Council used this as an opportunity to seize control of Coruscant. Pestage was incarcerated by local Imperial authorities on [[Ciutric IV]]; prompting the New Republic to attempt a rescue operation to encourage more defections. This attempt failed and Pestage was murdered by the warlord Admiral [[Delak Krennel]], who then took over Pestage's fiefdom. Meanwhile, Isard liquidated the entire Ruling Council and took over control of Coruscant; turning the capital into a fortress world against the advancing New Republic by fortifying it with Imperial reinforcements.<ref name="TEC" />

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Coruscant fell to Republic forces without [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|intense fighting]] after Alliance agents sabotaged the planet's shield generators. However, Isard had disappeared and infected the capital's alien populations with the deadly [[Krytos virus]] as a means of stirring tensions between humans and aliens. While the Republic managed to treat the virus with shipments of bacta from [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] following the [[Bacta War]], interspecies tensions remained rife. Later, Isard escaped Coruscant on the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', which doubled as a private prison buried beneath layers of urban sprawl. The event generated earthquakes which killed millions.<ref name="TEC" /> 

Though many Core worlds readily embraced the New Republic when the provisional government established itself on Coruscant, the vast majority resisted integration into the new government, primarily because they feared the consequences of allying themselves with the former Rebellion when there was still a very good chance that the Empire might rise again to eclipse the New Republic.<ref name=":0">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces seeding the space surrounding Coruscant with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]; effectively blockading the New Republic capital by disrupting space traffic and preventing the planetary defense forces from lowering the world's shield generators. With Thrawn's death, the blockade was ended. With the defeat of the Imperial warlord Krennel's forces, the New Republic deployed the majority of its Core-based naval units into the Outer Rim, leaving the strategically important region undefended.<ref name="TEC" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], after Grand Admiral Thrawn was assassinated during the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] under [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor's]] leadership gathered Imperial warlords to organize a brutal blitzkrieg that recaptured several key systems in the Core Worlds with days. Ralltiir, Chandrila, Duro, Kaikielius, [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], and [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] were quickly taken over by the Imperial forces. Admiral [[Sander Delvardus]] commenced an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] during the [[Battle of Metellos (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Metellos]], killing five billion inhabitants of the planet.<ref name="CCW" /> A sizable Imperial armada bombarded Coruscant, forcing Chief of State [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to evacuate the capital's population and relocate the New Republic to the Outer Rim. The Empire invaded the galactic capital and the Ruling Council summoned the political leaders and military commanders of the Empire to restore Imperial government. However, the Empire fell into a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] that devastated Coruscant and caused widespread destruction in the Empire. After several months of infighting between rival Imperial fleets and armies, Emperor Palpatine returned to conquer the galaxy. Following his first death during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Palpatine was reincarnated in a clone body at his secret throneworld of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the remote [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Having regained the Core Worlds, Palpatine was able to launch [[Operation Shadow Hand]] which targeted various "rebellious worlds" such as [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Da Soocha V]].<ref name="TEC" /> During these latest campaigns, the New Republic suffered mightily, reduced once again to a band of Rebels. Core Worlds such as Ralltiir, Chandrila, Esseles, and Coruscant itself fell back into Imperial hands. These events severely undermined the Republic's efforts, and many Core worlds remained hesitant or outright refused to join.<ref name=":0" />

With his final death in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the New Republic reclaimed most of the Core while the Empire was pushed backed to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and regions in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], that became collectively known as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The term "Imperial Core", or sometimes even simply "the Core", was used by supporters of both sides to denote areas of remaining Imperial control around the Galactic Center. Many Core Worlds outright refused to join the New Republic under any terms, maintaining loyalty to the Imperial system. These so-called “Imperial Core Worlds” had prospered under Palpatine’s regime, with their political elites often owing their status to the Empire. Their leadership and populations preferred aiding the remaining Imperial warlords, hoping to retain a privileged role in any future restored Empire. This usage persisted even when Coruscant and most of the historic Core Worlds had joined under New Republic, and the Imperial holdouts in the area were mostly restricted to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and the fringes of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. <ref name=":0" />

Numerous Imperial warlords—whether driven by loyalty to the old regime or personal ambition—retreated to these Imperial Core systems. There they bickered, consolidated resources, and awaited the rise of a unifying leader. That hope briefly reignited with Palpatine’s return, but upon his final death, the Imperial Core began to contract inward. Without central leadership, the region stagnated, and the New Republic entered a tenuous period of recovery and uncertain peace.<ref name=":0" />

Until [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the Core Worlds remained largely stable and prosperous except for brief minor disturbances like the [[Corellian Crisis]] and the [[Second Imperium Crisis]]. During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] ([[16 ABY/Legends|16]]&ndash;[[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]), the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]] was deployed against the xenophobic [[Yevetha]]n [[Duskhan League]] which perpetuated genocide in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]]. In 17 ABY, the [[Senate Hall]] on Coruscant was bombed during the [[Almanian Uprising]]; killing and wounding many senators. Core-based Republic forces were also deployed against the Deep Core warlords.<ref name="TEC" />

During the Corellian Crisis in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], the [[Sacorria]]n [[Sacorrian Triad|Triad]] attempted to secede the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] by supporting various separatist factions in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and then kidnapping a Republic delegation led by Chief of State Leia. However, one of these groups&mdash;the extremist [[Human League]] led by [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] turned on their Triad bosses by using Centerpoint Station to generate an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]] that blocked all travel to and from the system. The Sacorrian Triad used Centerpoint to destroy three planetary systems in the Core including [[Bovo Yagen system/Legends|Bovo Yagen]].<ref name="TEC" />

Tensions between the Human League and its Sacorrian backers reached a climax when Thrackan attempted to secede the sector with himself as leader. Deactivating the interdiction field, the Sacorrians deployed a war fleet which was by [[Bakuran]] and New Republic forces during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Corellian Crisis)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]]. With this defeat, the New Republic reasserted control over the Corellian sector and apprehended the rebels. To alleviate tensions between the region and the Coruscant government, the [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] [[Marcha]] was appointed the sector's new [[Governor/Legends|Governor-General]]. However, many Corellians still yearned for independence and resented New Republic intervention. Despite the normalization of foreign relations and trade with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Republic still faced resistance from splinter factions like the [[Second Imperium]] which raided Coruscant for supplies and recruits in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].<ref name="TEC" />

===[[Yuuzhan Vong War]]===
[[File:Durosurface.jpg|thumb|200px|A green [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] following the Yuuzhan Vong War]]
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25]]-[[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]), the Core Worlds were an important target for the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in their path for galactic domination. Since Yuuzhan Vong advances were initially concentrated in the outlying Outer Rim, the Core Worlds were reluctant to commit resources and indifferent to the plight of outlying worlds. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], this changed with further Yuuzhan Vong advances into the Mid Rim, Expansion Region, [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and an ill-fated strike on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] in the nearby Colonies. Under the auspices of the [[Senate Select Committee for Refugees]], billions of displaced refugees were relocated to Duro which was believed to be safe from further enemy incursions.<ref name="TNEC" />

However, the newly arrived [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] ordered a change in battle plans and the planet was attacked by a massive Yuuzhan Vong fleet which destroyed the planet's orbital cities and killed many refugees. In an attempt to stir [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]], the Yuuzhan Vong offered to cease their invasion in exchange for all Jedi being handed over to the invaders. Several prominent Core Worlds politicians including [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viqi Shesh]] and Corellian Governor-General Thrackan Sal-Solo covertly collaborated with the invaders. Following their success at Duro, Yuuzhan Vong forces seized New Plympto and [[Talfaglio]] in the Corellian sector in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> followed by Ralltiir, Kuat and Kaikielius.

On New Plympto, they were opposed by a [[New Plympto resistance (Yuuzhan Vong War)|resistance army]] led by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] Jedi sisters [[Alema Rar|Alema]] and [[Numa Rar]]. In response, the Yuuzhan Vong occupiers depopulated the planet with a virus. In response to New Republic resistance, the Yuuzhan Vong attempted to execute refugees in Talfaglio but were thwarted by a Jedi raid. In response, the invaders attacked the galactic capital Coruscant with a massive fleet. During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|subsequent battle]], both sides sustained massive casualties and the Chief of State [[Borsk Fey'lya]] was slain.<ref name="TNEC" />

The Yuuzhan Vong then proceeded to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] Coruscant in the image of their primeval homeworld of [[Yuuzhan'tar]]. They introduced exotic species from their [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|home galaxy]], altered much of the planet's landmarks and even altered its climate by using [[dovin basal]]s to shift it closer to [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]]. Much of the former cityscape was covered in vegetation while one of its moons was destroyed to create a large asteroid field known as the [[Rings of Coruscant|Rainbow Bridge]]. Thus, Coruscant became the center of the new [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]]. Similar projects were undertaken on Duro which was transformed into a lush forested world; reversing millennia of pollution and neglect.<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the New Republic's successor state&mdash;the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] retook Coruscant following a [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|massive battle]] that saw the demise of the Yuuzhan Vong [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] and a class uprising among the lowly [[Worker caste]] and [[Shamed Ones]] inspired by the nascent [[Jeedai heresy]]. The Yuuzhan Vong were relocated to the sentient world of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]]&mdash;a seed of the original Yuuzhan'tar. With the recapture of Coruscant and the reversal of the terraforming processes, Coruscant once again assumed its role as the galactic capital in [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" />

===[[Legacy era]]===
Following its reconstruction, Coruscant again became the galactic capital while the Core Worlds gradually recovered its former economic and cultural power. On Duro, Yuuzhan Vong terraforming efforts succeeded in restoring a lush, habitable environment.<ref name="CCW" /> During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], peace and recovery efforts were hampered by fighting between the Alliance and the secessionist [[Confederation]] led by the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] was [[Solo-Niathal coup|overthrown]] by the former Jedi-turned Sith Lord [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]] which divided the Alliance further into factions loyal to Jacen and the opposition [[Jedi Coalition]]. With the end of fighting in [[41 ABY]], former Imperial admiral [[Natasi Daala]] became the new Chief of State though the Core Worlds remained divided between the Alliance and Confederation.<ref name="TEA" />

Prior to the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the Galactic Alliance and the [[Fel Empire]] signed a [[Treaty of Anaxes|treaty]] on Anaxes where the two would defend each other in the events of threat from aggressive powers. Following the sabotage of the [[Ossus Project]], the Fel Empire took advantage of rampant anti-Vong sentiment to invoke war on the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="SWL0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> Within three years, much of the Core including Coruscant passed into the hands of the [[Fel Empire]] under [[Roan Fel]] which was usurped by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] in [[130 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The now lush world of Duro became an Imperial stronghold and was the site of the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] where the most talented Duros instructed Imperial pilots and capital ship crewmen.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

As of [[137 ABY]], resistance to the Sith-led Empire in the Core Worlds continued in the form of the Alliance's [[Core Fleet|Core Forces]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] throughout the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" /> While much of the fighting occurred in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the [[Temple of the Sith]] on Coruscant was raided by the former Jedi [[Cade Skywalker]]. Later, a joint Galactic Alliance and Fel Empire fleet attacked Ralltiir and [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|decimated]] the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]]; forcing the Sith Empire to divert more forces to defend the strategically important Core world.<ref name="SWL36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>

==Astrography==
The Core contained millions of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace roots]] including the five busiest hyperlanes of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />
